entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF88912.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order. That was VF88912?
Yes. VF88912.

Got it. I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered back on December 15th. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or just a preference?
It's a preference. I don't need troubleshooting. I need to return it. I tried to do this on your website two weeks ago and it was broken.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the website. Can you tell me more about what happened when you tried to process the return?

I tried on December 24th. The whole return portal gave me a huge 'website error' message. It said the system down for maintenance or something. I even took a screenshot. After that, the holidays started and this is my first chance to call. So, can you process this or not?

Thank you for that information, and I do apologize for that experience. Let me just check our system logs for that date... Yes, I can confirm we had a known outage that day. It seems the whole returns module was impacted and customers couldn't print their labels. That must have been very frustrating.
It was. So, what's the solution?
Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility based on your delivery date... Okay, it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window.
Good. So you're sending me a label?

Yes. Given the system issue you encountered, I've approved the return. I am generating a pre-paid return label and emailing it to you right now. You should see it in your inbox in the next few minutes.
And it's a full refund to my credit card?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives and processes the item, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. That typically takes 5-7 business days.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
